name: goaway-drains-then-closes
description: The acceptor goes away with one stream already in flight and one opened a moment too late. The stream at or below last_stream finishes inside the drain window (WSM-CON-024); the late one is answered with reset(REFUSED) by the peer that is going away (WSM-CON-021), is refused locally by its opener, and has nothing sent for it (WSM-CON-023); the socket then closes (WSM-CON-025). last_stream carries the *other* peer's parity, which is why it is written here as an ordinal the runner resolves rather than as a number (WSM-CON-020, WSM-TST-002).
